name: Historic Town of Grand-Bassam
description: Grand-Bassam, on the Gulf of Guinea coast of Côte d'Ivoire, was the country's first capital and its busiest port. Its old quarter still shows the colonial plan, with separate districts for trade, administration, and European and African housing. Wander past airy houses with verandas, galleries and gardens, then reach the N'zima fishing village, where local life carries on.
